items.title: Progressive Chicago Alderman Pranks Conservative Colleague With A Giant Abdul El-Sayed Cut-Out
items.description: Ald. Andre Vasquez recently swapped out Ald. Nicholas Sposato's cardboard cutout of President Donald Trump with a cutout of Michigan Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed.

items.title: Every Cook County Circuit Judge Wins Retention, But Voter Scrutiny Is Growing
items.description: All 61 on the ballot won this year, but a record 19 received less than 70% of voter support.

items.title: Barba Yianni Grecian Taverna Reopens In Lincoln Square With New Name, Fresh Look
items.description: The longtime Greek restaurant — now called Grecian Taverna — had been closed for more than year due to a commercial eviction, which owner Anas Ihmoud resolved.

items.title: Want To Help Rescue Food In Chicago? There’s An App For That
items.description: Chicago Food Rescue celebrated its second anniversary in October. The group uses an app and volunteers to deliver surplus food across the city.

items.title: New Woodlawn Development Brings Building To Vacant Lot For 1st Time In 15 Years
items.description: The $1.08 million project includes an insurance agency, mental health clinic, offices for the developers and three market-rate apartments.

items.title: Recent Evictions At Lathrop Homes Have Residents Under A ‘Pressure Cooker Of Stress’
items.description: Tenants at the historic North Side housing development say one of the site’s managers and developers, Related Midwest, is increasingly displacing families as another stage of redevelopment gets underway.

items.title: 10 Chicago-Themed Card And Board Games To Play This Holiday Season
items.description: Bring the entertainment to your parties with games that challenge players to tackle the city’s rat problem, find the best CTA route and rebuild after the Great Chicago Fire.

items.title: Englewood’s Landmark US Bank Building For Sale As Owners Eye Drive-Thru Site
items.description: Tenants in the building, which include the nonprofit Teamwork Englewood, were notified about the sale earlier this month. The move is scheduled for late next year.
